description: .NET version upgrade plan from net8.0 to net10.0 for eShopOnWeb

tasks.reason: The user explicitly requested an upgrade to the latest LTS version. .NET 10.0 is the current latest LTS, providing improved performance, new language features, and long-term support beyond the .NET 8.0 lifecycle.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade all projects in the eShopOnWeb solution (ApplicationCore, BlazorAdmin, BlazorShared, Infrastructure, PublicApi, Web, and all test projects) from net8.0 to net10.0. The TargetFramework is defined centrally in Directory.Packages.props — update it there. Also update global.json SDK version from 8.0.x to 10.0.x, and update all NuGet package references (Microsoft.AspNetCore.*, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.*, and other dependencies) to versions compatible with .NET 10. Resolve any breaking API changes between .NET 8 and .NET 10. Ensure all projects build successfully and all unit and integration tests pass.
tasks.summary: Successfully upgraded eShopOnWeb from .NET 8.0 to .NET 10.0. Updated TargetFramework in Directory.Packages.props, updated global.json SDK to 10.0.100, upgraded all Microsoft.AspNetCore.*, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.*, Microsoft.Extensions.* packages to 10.0.12, fixed breaking API changes (removed obsolete serialization constructor, fixed TimeSpan ambiguity, resolved Program type conflict, updated AutoMapper 16.x API). All 74 tests pass (UnitTests: 44, IntegrationTests: 3, FunctionalTests: 12, PublicApiIntegrationTests: 15).
